versions.statement: Chen tends to dwell on losing trades, analyzing them far more than winning trades, which often leads to indecision.
Chen aims to develop confidence in his trading strategy to mitigate second-guessing his analysis.
Chen prefers using a combination of moving averages and RSI for his trading decisions.
Chen struggles with time management, often spending excessive hours analyzing charts without executing trades.
Chen frequently misses optimal entry signals due to overthinking potential outcomes.
Chen has improved in catching entry signals promptly by setting predefined entry rules and alarms, which reduced his overthinking.
Chen exhibits a conservative risk tolerance, preferring trades with higher probability and lower potential reward.
